description: Structured record of the pull request the launch smoke test opened. Composed into the fixed launch-result envelope's `output` property on a cloud launch, so a launch of this skill surfaces the PR under `result.output` and the recipe validates it against this schema.

pr_url.description: URL of the pull request the smoke test opened.

pr_number.description: Number of the opened pull request, when the SCM exposes one. Optional (pr_url is the stable identifier).

branch.description: The branch the PR was opened from (e.g. `launch-smoke-test/20260709-140501`).

issue_identifier.description: The Linear issue the smoke test read (e.g. `AE-669`), tying the PR back to the Linear half of the check.
